procedural_matters: CZE 3570 is reppresented by Karolyn LojKova ITA 3582 is reppresented by Franceso Calotto
facts: At the moment of the incident, the wind was less than 10 knots, and the lake was almost calm.
CZE 3570 was sailing on port tack, inside, while ITA was sailing on starboard tack, aiming for mark 2S.
When entering the zone, ITA 3582 was overlapped with CZE 3570, bow to bow.
During the rounding of the mark, there was contact between the port amidships of CZE 3570 and the starboard amidships of ITA 3582.
No boat took a penalty turn.
There were no injuries or damage, and both boats finished the race.
conclusions: ITA 3582 outside overlapped at the zone failed to give CZE 3570 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(1).
